purpose: Explain parked battery loss using deterministic statistics, historical parked windows, current Park evidence, plugged/unplugged attribution and optional AI narration.
primaryGoal: Identify the observed parked-drain rate and likely actionable culprit without confusing missing evidence, live Park status and historical sample coverage.

dataSources.name: Drain statistics
dataSources.behavior: Enabled only with selected vehicle; key ['vampire-drain-stats', activeId]; AbortSignal forwarded. Handler fixes sample to 90 days and caps raw statistic events at 5000 (handler.go:47-69,118-120,217-219). Nullable mean/median/P95 remain unknown; observed hours become seconds only for the duration presentation metric.

dataSources.name: Parked-drain sessions and charts
dataSources.behavior: Vehicle-keyed and cancellable; no server offset or client date bounds sent. Handler uses a fixed 365-day event lookback (handler.go:54-59,167-169), not the statistics' 90-day coverage. Successful absent event slice normalized to [] by handler.go:176-178. Same loaded rows feed sorting, rate trend and vehicle-timezone daily rollup; not a full-range chart.

dataSources.name: Current Park evidence
dataSources.behavior: Live query policy, vehicle-scoped key, enablement and cancellation preserved; feeds VampireCulpritPanel. ParkTruth includes confirmed Park, reported versus counted switches, rejected reasons and honesty (web\src\types\teslaPhysics.ts:60-73). Backend freshness and derivation were not exercised.

dataSources.name: Complete-plugged versus unplugged windows
dataSources.behavior: Historical policy; same query key reused by culprit and split panels, not two competing server caches. Complete-plugged rows precede unplugged rows; nullable split percentages, server honesty and raw duration_s retained. Exact server bounds unknown.

dataSources.name: Optional narration
dataSources.routeEvidence: internal\api\router.go:1971,5075 identifies handler wiring; exact generated route registration not inspected
dataSources.behavior: Opt-in gate; vehicle_id plus positive lookback_days from statistic sample; stream identity includes both. Scope changes abort and clear narration. Shared AIFeatureCard owns start button, streaming disablement and output state. Narration never replaces deterministic panels; backend POST success unverified.

dataSources.name: Workspace and display preferences
dataSources.hook: useSelectedVehicle, useTimezone('vehicle'), useUnits, useNumberFormatting, useMetricPreferences, useTranslation
dataSources.behavior: No competing vehicle selector. Both aliases have vehicle scope and no header date range according to web\src\lib\workspaceScope.ts:23-77,171-178. Celsius converted only when displayed; localDayKey assigns complete events to their start day. Date helper timezone behavior beyond inspected callers unverified.

components.role: Existing full-width orchestration and allocated-container reflow; no replacement surface/layout engine.

components.props: id/title/description/metrics/period/loading/retained/secondary bridged to compact OperationalBrief; raw measurements, source reason, status, scope and review drawer remain.
components.role: Shared evidence summary reused for four primary KPIs, five culprit readings and two split readings. Gauge retains median/P95 in StatGroup.

components.props: Panels take vehicleId: string | undefined; SourceRecovery takes DataState<unknown> and localized label.
components.role: Page-specific attribution and independent recovery; no speculative universal culprit component.

components.name: EmbeddedChart / LinearGauge
components.role: Canonical chart framing, accessible data alternatives and measurement visualization.

components.props: Stable tableId/caption/columns/data/keyExtractor/mobilePresentation; sessions retain sorting/compact/pagination. Split retains name and original grouping order.
components.role: Single production table pipeline; mobile adapter preserves hidden battery fields through table-owned details, pending runtime proof.

components.role: Existing opt-in narration and streaming UI; disabled no-vehicle/in-flight action, error/output lifecycle delegated.

components.owner: Existing UI, feedback and motion category barrels
components.role: Localized controls, semantic severity, typography and explicit no-vehicle/empty/loading states. Underlying focus/motion behavior not exercised.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Median and P95 appear in both summary metrics and gauge StatGroup. Culprit honesty is repeated in brief description and caption (VampireCulpritPanel.tsx:90,97); split honesty appears above and inside its brief (VampireSplitPanel.tsx:51-52). These are source-backed noise candidates, not permission to delete measurements or limitations.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Give summary, gauge and evidence notes distinct jobs; retain every metric/context in the canonical brief and its accessible details while removing only redundant visible prose after parity review.

strategies: CardGrid uses allocated container width, packing and shared Grid (CardGrid.tsx:25-39), not hardcoded viewport-only feature grids.
Both charts specify desktop height 288 and mobile height 224 (VampireDrainPage.tsx:330-331,433-434).
Refresh has min-h-11/min-w-11 (VampireDrainPage.tsx:239); source retry uses min-h-11, max-w-full and wrapping (SourceRecovery.tsx:24).

Session mobile roles include hidden start/end percentages and visible rate, ambient and duration; allDetails adds ended_at (sessionPresentation.ts:35-44). Split details add end time, duration, start/end SOC and Park confirmation (VampireSplitPanel.tsx:68-74).
responsive.requiredReview: Exercise 320/375/390/430/768/1024/1280/1440/1920/2560, narrow allocated width, long translated labels, RTL and 200% text. Verify chart toolbars, table details, review drawers, empty/error states and no horizontal page clipping.

accessibility.status: runtime keyboard, focus, screen reader, contrast, forced colors and target geometry unverified
sourceStrengths: Localized accessible name on refresh; icon aria-hidden (VampireDrainPage.tsx:241-242).
Three stable labeled Section IDs and labeled CardGrids; chart ariaLabel/dataColumns and table captions supplied.
Localized recovery group and independent retry; onboarding links supplied for no-vehicle states.
Semantic badges communicate severity in addition to numeric loss readings; shared evidence drawer retained.

issues.detail: Gauge passes threshold-dependent color but no status prop. The thresholds 1.5 and 3 at lines 206-208 are not communicated as a qualitative label; shared LinearGauge explicitly supports an accessible status (LinearGauge.tsx:76-88). Caption explains only the approximately 5%/day reference.
issues.fix: Pass a localized qualitative status and existing semantic tone using the same thresholds; retain numeric reading, explicit reference and all gauge context.

states.loading: Stats and events independently classified by useDataState. Summary brief loading, chart/gauge/session skeletons; culprit loading only while both sources initial, so partial sources remain useful. Split has own skeleton.
states.empty: All main analytical sections stay mounted. No selected vehicle offers /onboarding. Empty successful events give chart placeholders and table emptyMessage; null mean gives gauge EmptyState. Split null payload gives unavailable measurements message.
states.error: SourceRecovery shows fatal errors or retained refresh warning plus retry; sessions include fatal retry action. Statistics failure does not remove events, culprit or split; physics recovery remains panel-local.
states.staleOffline: Retained payloads stay present; summary/culprit/split expose retained badges, refresh failures/paused recovery use SourceRecovery. SourceRecovery does not display age-only stale status without a refresh error/paused flag; this is an observation, not proof of global trust omission because PageContainer was not inspected.
states.disabled: Statistics/events and physics queries disabled without selected vehicle; AI gate independent and action disabled without valid positive ID or while streaming. Refresh button itself remains enabled when no vehicle is selected.
states.partial: Culprit derivation retains independently available Park and split evidence; missing measurements use null/status placeholders rather than inventing watts.

issues.detail: Derived honesty appends a fixed English sentence, then VampireCulpritPanel.tsx:90,97 presents it directly. Locale fallback values are not the same as this unconditional English user-visible text.
issues.fix: Keep server honesty verbatim and preserve its evidence meaning; localize only the frontend-authored explanatory sentence using the existing catalog/translation owner without moving queries into renderers.

visualIssues.detail: Gauge health uses positional CHART_COLORS[2/3/5] as success/warning/danger despite a semantic tone API already existing. This couples status presentation to series palette choices. No page-local neon, glow or fixed white styling was found by the scoped count.
visualIssues.fix: Use LinearGauge tone='success'|'warning'|'danger' for the unchanged thresholds plus localized status; preserve theme/custom/chart palette preferences and keep categorical chart series distinct.

visualIssues.detail: A LayoutCard contains a compact BatteryEvidenceBrief which itself renders OperationalBrief's GlassPanel; split does likewise at VampireSplitPanel.tsx:52. Nested surfaces plus repeated explanation can increase chrome relative to the readings. Actual visual severity unverified.
visualIssues.fix: Review an existing-owner embedded evidence presentation rather than introducing another card; retain all readings, source recovery, review drawer and honesty.

architectureIssues.detail: Two requests and response interfaces are owned by the 518-line page rather than domain API hooks; charts, rollup utility, columns and rendering share the orchestrator. Existing cancellation/vehicle keys are sound and must not be rewritten gratuitously.
architectureIssues.fix: Extract the two typed domain queries to the existing battery API hook owner and pure daily bucketing to a battery utility; retain enablement, keys, default query policies, signal forwarding, rows, bounds and behavior. Decompose only with complete feature inventory.

architectureIssues.detail: Split and culprit feature files import LayoutCard from @/components/layout/layout-reference rather than the documented @/components/layout production barrel. Stat preferences/types also use stat-reference subpaths (page:13; culprit:4).
architectureIssues.fix: Use supported category exports where available; do not replace current implementations or create wrappers solely to rename imports.

architectureIssues.detail: GAUGE_MAX=5 is a reference, but page does not pass preserveReadingAndScale. LinearGauge.tsx:147-151 clamps and prints clamped value by default: averages greater than 5 would display 5 rather than the actual average. This follows source logic; no mounted reproduction performed.
architectureIssues.fix: Use the existing preserveReadingAndScale API so out-of-reference readings stay accurate without publishing invalid meter ranges; retain the approximate 5%/day explanatory caption and source value.

architectureIssues.detail: Both aliases lack header range enablement, use no useRangeState and have independently scoped 90-day stats versus 365-day/200-row events. Page honestly states server/loaded-window limitations; changing this is an endpoint/integration dependency, not a presentation-only date picker fix.
architectureIssues.fix: Preserve present sample coverage now. If workspace range is adopted, extend server list/stats with both bounds, wire typed keys and both aliases through workspaceScope, retain rolling/custom/timezone semantics and disclose loaded versus full-range charts. Do not filter only 200 loaded rows or invent supported bounds.

architectureIssues.detail: Daily rollup null-coalesces event loss and hours to zero even though local interfaces declare them required. Malformed/partial event data could become a measured-zero chart. Backend repository nullability/guarantees were not inspected; risk is conditional.
architectureIssues.fix: Verify actual event contract first; preserve valid-event start-day grouping and sums. If missing values are possible, represent incomplete buckets explicitly through the existing data-state/chart path rather than inventing zero or dropping unrelated known readings.

architectureIssues.detail: Header 'Refresh vampire drain' refetches only stats/events, while culprit and split use Park and physics vampire queries. dataSources lists only the two local queries (129-145), so page-level refresh/source inventory is narrower than the full page.
architectureIssues.fix: Either clearly name the limited refresh scope or register independent physics sources using existing query/source ownership; avoid duplicate caches, always retain source-local retries and do not refresh optional AI automatically.

priority.reason: Source-confirmed gauge can truncate high readings and threshold meaning lacks accessible status. Existing modernization primitives are mostly in place; broader visual acceptance is still pending.

observations: Two calls to useVampireSplit share the same physics key and policy, not distinct implementations.
Page-local baseline requests duplicate query orchestration responsibility but target different endpoints than physics split.
No alternate table, date picker, chart engine, token engine or vehicle selector introduced by inspected page.
BatteryEvidenceBrief already consolidates evidence rendering; retain it rather than copying OperationalBrief markup.

preservation.sectionCountingMethod: Seven top-level content groups; nine leaf user-facing panels counting the two cards in each trend/daily group. AI group is legitimately conditional on feature gate. JSX contains three explicit Section, six LayoutCard and two EmbeddedChart calls in the page; the no-vehicle summary LayoutCard is an alternative, not an extra simultaneous panel.

dataBehavior: Keep both route aliases mounted to identical lazy page through SafeRoute (App.tsx:76,654-661).
Keep request paths unprefixed and snake_case vehicle_id; preserve response wire/cache values and abort signals.
Keep mean/median/P95 nullable, loss threshold badges (>5 danger, >2 warning, otherwise success), gauge threshold boundaries <=1.5/<=3, and independently known source evidence.
Keep current baseline server lookbacks, 200 loaded event limit and explicit period uncertainty until supported integration changes are assigned.
Keep invalid start-date omission and chronological/local start-day aggregation; do not reinterpret events as midnight-split windows without separate behavioral authority.
Keep sort default started_at, trend oldest-first, tables' stable identities battery:vampire-drain-sessions and vampire-split, row identity started_at and kind-started_at.
Preserve duration_hours and total_observed_hours current backend shapes; UI duration metric multiplies by 3600 and split duration_s divides only for display.
Keep data-source failures local; retained observations must survive refresh errors and optional AI must never displace measurements.
No vehicle command is executed by educational tips or culprit action text.
